findings.rationale: The aws_security_group.jump in tf_chain_ingress_role opens port 22 TCP to 0.0.0.0/0, exposing SSH to the entire internet without source restriction.
The aws_iam_role.escalation in tf_chain_ingress_role allows sts:AssumeRole for account 123456789012 root and is attached to AWS managed AdministratorAccess, enabling trivial privilege escalation.
The connectivity.json edge from sg-jump to role-escalate via sts:AssumeRole creates an unbroken network-to-identity attack path from the internet-facing jump host to the admin role.
The aws_iam_policy.wildcard in tf_iam_open grants Action=* on Resource=* without any conditions or scoping, providing unrestricted API-level access to any assumed identity.

The wildcard IAM policy in tf_iam_open (Statement[0] Action=* Resource=*) chains directly to the public-read S3 ACL in tf_s3_public_access, meaning any assumed identity can enumerate and read all objects in the bucket.
